course_name_en: KMM3532 — Mathematical Modeling in Chemical Engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Able to establish mathematical models for chemical engineering processes.
Able to solve problems related to chemical engineering processes using numerical methods.
Able to solve ordinary and partial differential equations.
Able to establish mathematical models for chemical engineering processes using computer-aided programs.
Able to solve problems related to chemical engineering processes using different methods through individual study.

syllabus_topics: Evaluation of Data Related to Chemical Engineering Processes
Plotting Non-linear Functions in Linear Form
Modeling of Steady-state and Dynamic Systems
Development of Model Equations and Solution Methods
Solutions of Ordinary and Partial Differential Equations
Solving Equations using Computer Package Programs
bibliography: Process Modelling, Simulation and Control for Chemical Engineers, Luyben, L.M., 2nd ed., McGraw-Hill, 1990.
Modelling and Simulation in Chemical Engineering, Franks, G.E.R., Wiley, 1972.
academic_year: vigente en el Bologna Bilgi Sistemi (Yeni)
